depin.rewards-12m.definition: USD value of contributor rewards paid by Solana DePIN networks per year.
depin.rewards-12m.note: Unverified; Syndica's Dec 2025 DePIN deep dive reports just over $100M in 2025 payouts across nine tracked protocols (a narrower measure).

depin.transactions-30d.definition: Monthly transactions by Solana DePIN programs.
depin.transactions-30d.note: No public dated source found; the data-api has no DePIN breakdown.

depin.peak-users.definition: Peak daily users across Solana DePIN networks.
depin.peak-users.note: No aggregate source found; Helium alone reported 3.39M daily users on 2026-02-14 (SolanaFloor), a narrower but larger figure.

depin.helium.daily-users.definition: Daily active users connected through the Helium network, as stated on helium.com (undated; asOf is the check date).

depin.hivemapper.road-coverage.definition: Share of the world's roads with unique Bee Maps (Hivemapper) coverage, as stated on beemaps.com (undated; asOf is the check date).

depin.render.frames-rendered.definition: Lifetime frames rendered on the Render Network (Render Foundation stats dashboard; asOf is the check date).

depin.grass.data-per-day.definition: Gigabytes of web data scraped per day by the Grass network.
depin.grass.data-per-day.note: grass.io shows only a user count (8.5M) and no data volume; no dated source found, and 1B GB per day looks implausible.

depin.geodnet.stations.note: GEODNET's Oct 2025 Business Wire release reportedly cites 20,000+ active stations, but the page returned 403 and geodnet.com counters did not render, so the replacement was not confirmed.
